# SeaTalk Developer Tools

The SeaTalk Web App Developer Tools aims to help developers develop their SeaTalk Web Apps more efficiently by providing an IDE to help with debugging and previewing Web Apps.

# Features Supported

* Debugging and previewing your Web Apps through URL
* Trying out Web SDK functions with an official demo

# Download The Tool

* [MacOS](https://static.cdn.haiserve.com/seatalk/static/client/sop/devtools/test/darwin-x64-prod-0.0.10/SeaTalkDevTools-0.0.10.dmg)
* [Windows-64-bit](https://static.cdn.haiserve.com/seatalk/static/client/sop/devtools/test/win32-x64-prod-0.0.10/SeaTalkDevTools-0.0.10-setup.exe)

# How to Use

* Enter your Web App's URL in Toolbar section and hit "Enter"
